name: Synn
message: 「Feel like time's been flying by lately」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's call it a day then」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's up, Misa? You're pale as a ghost」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If there's nothing there, then what's the big deal」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go home, Nanaka. Huh, what's wrong?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ahem, well. From the quick peek yours truly just took... looks like the world went and got destroyed or something」

name: Misa
message: 「J-Just because there's nothing outside doesn't mean the world was destroyed, no way!」

name: Sally
message: 「Well, I'll go scout around a bit!」

name: Synn
message: 「We didn't notice because it's gotten dark, right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「According to the guidebook, someone named Nostradamus prophesied this」

name: Sally
message: 「It's crazy! The Student Council room is floating in completely empty space!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Anyway. First, we need to find out what caused the world to end」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even if we find out, there's nothing we can do about what's already destroyed」

name: Paqy
message: 「More importantly, let's think about the future. We've gotta become Adam and Eve, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sh-Synn and me!?　W-w-w-whoa, wh-what do I do!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hiss. You weren't even on my radar from the start!　Ria-chan, let's make babies together to rebuild humanity!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah. Getting turned down even in a situation like this!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Somehow I am the only one left out. Hmph」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shall we grab some ramen or something on the way back」

name: Synn
message: 「It's always beef bowl with you, Sally-chan」

name: Misa
message: 「Why are you all escaping from reality!　Even the shopping district is completely gone!」

name: Synn
message: 「How did things end up like this……」

name: Paqy
message: 「Like I said. Unless we can go back to the past, digging into the cause is pointless」

name: Sally
message: 「So we just need to go back to the past?」

name: Ria
message: 「Does Demon World Mail-Order even have that kind of item?」
Somehow, that car looks vaguely familiar.

name: Sally
message: 「Zipping straight to the past or the present, 'Perorian'!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Does it even work? I really can't trust the gadgets Omake-san brings out」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What is this! It's just a bicycle with a car-like body cover slapped over it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Wait, seriously!? It's human-powered!? And it's a Demon World gadget!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, standing around here forever won't get us anywhere」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm starting to get kind of excited♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Guess we've got no choice but to steel ourselves, J!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I suppose we don't have a choice……」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone's aboard, right? Sally-chan, can you set the time we return to?」

name: Sally
message: 「I can set it pretty much accurately, so leave it to me!」

name: Misa
message: 「You at least inspected this thing, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hiss. Asking a question when you already know you won't get a decent answer is foolish」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm just asking a completely normal question!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah! Being decisive is what makes a true Edoite!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'll follow you to the depths of hell」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, let's hurry! I can't wait to see what happens!」
We all stomp on the pedals at once!
The sensation of accelerating faster and faster!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are we the only ones left behind!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Looks like only that thing ended up crossing through time」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, that. It's the one left over after I put it back together」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now, now. Since it's Omake's mecha, it wouldn't have worked even without a leftover screw」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, if it's Sally's mecha, guess it can't be helped」
